scope: Twelve dialogue/caption units transcribed from a previously unused page on 2026-10-08. This page becomes a development case after inspection. SFX, tiny margin comments and graphic labels are not scored; not whole-page ground truth. The source spells creaure without t.

units.text: I could get a creaure to eat me and ingest the poison, but that will probably end up killing me too.
Somehow I need to poison them without doing that.
Just, Even if I can make poison, I can't get it out of my body.
That's right! I can just combine the poison with Water Edge!
